label: English comfort level
description: How comfortable do you feel reading, listening to and communicating in English? This will help us assign additional resources to supporting you with reading and writing assignments. Please feel free to elaborate. You can share if you feel more comfortable reading and writing over listening and speaking, or the other way around. You can mention if and what you have written in English, e.g. letters, essays, comments on social media, or whether you're used to watching English-language movies with subtitles, etc.

label: Arabic comfort level
description: How comfortable do you feel reading, listening to and communicating in Arabic? Sometimes class discussions mix English and Egyptian Arabic. Rest assured, however, that everything gets translated in the end. Also let us know if you're learning or are interested in learning Arabic, or if you have any experience writing fiction, journalism or poetry in Arabic, and have experience translating from English to Arabic or from Arabic to English.

A cartoon-based essay
description: Write a short essay of 250 words based on the cartoon below. There is no boxes to tick, no right interpretation to offer, no particular answer to give. Rather you're invited to share your thoughts on and how you related or did not relate to this image, the/your notion of home, and happiness, jobs and work. For instance, home could refer to your living space, your personal space, your home country. Be creative!

A review-based essay
description: Write a short, analytical essay of 250 words based on an article in English or Arabic of your interest. This could also be a book chapter and should be no less than a 1000 words long. You might find an interesting article on the following websites: https://aeon.co/; https://www.jadaliyya.com/; https://www.newyorker.com/; https://www.vice.com/ar; https://madamasr.com/en; https://thepointmag.com/; https://jacobinmag.com/, or on any website, outlet or publication of your choice. In this essay share with us how this article is of interest to you, how you relate to it and what you learned from it. Please share with us the source, author and title of the article or book chapter you chose.
